desc: A small standing FIGURINE of fired reddish CLAY: a very simple stylised human figure with arms crossed over the chest, a round head without a face, cracked and chipped. an ancient sacred relic of the first ten humans, small, weathered and very old, seen from the high three-quarter top-down game camera, standing upright on its own (no stand, no table, no ground) as it would sit on a small offering tray.
